newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel to distribute 50 pct 1998 profits - paper.
newsitem.headline: Telecel to distribute 50 pct 1998 profits - paper.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel will distribute 50 percent of its net profits in 1998 as dividends, the Diario Economico paper quoted financial analysts of SBC Warburg as saying.
SBC Warburg is one of the global coordinators in the flotation of a 35.6 percent stake in Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessois, expected to be completed in Lisbon by December 10.

SBC Warburg analysts expect Telecel to post profits of seven billion escudos this year, 10 billion in 1997 and 13 billion in 1998, the paper quoted the analysts as saying at a road show to promote the flotation in London on.
Telecel's revenues would grow to 70 billion escudos in 1997 from 55 billion expected this year.
Telecel and TMN-Telecomunicacoes Moveis Nacionais, a unit of Portugal Telecom, are the only two operators in Portugal's mobile phone market.
